content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CUSB Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CUSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 10 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CUSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the posts of Research Associate-I, Project Associate-I, and Scientific Administrative Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their applications to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Scientific Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Scientific Administrative Assistant position, candidates need a Graduate degree in a science discipline with a minimum of 60% marks. Practical knowledge in Bioinformatics is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Research Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Research Associate-I position is ₹58,000 plus 9% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for CUSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an offline interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the positions advertised by CUSB?
faq.answer: The job type for all the advertised positions is temporary.

faq.question: Q9. Which department is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Department of Biotechnology, Central University of South Bihar, under a Government of India funded project.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Central University of South Bihar located?
faq.answer: The Central University of South Bihar is located in Gaya, Bihar, with the pincode 824236.
